title: Project categories line up
summary:
A small cleanup day: project categories and names got tidier, and the README gained an assessment badge.

The site’s project list now includes creative apps and tools/interfaces, matching the categories used to organize featured projects.

The directory now calls KoboldAI Lite by its correct name and no longer puts manually added 🆕 markers in project names.

The README gained a badge linking to Pollinations’ MseeP.ai listing. It changes no application code or security behavior.
